description: Lean MORe kernel. One invariant organises everything: every artifact is held exactly once; everything else is a pointer or a lossless, regenerable projection. Relations, gates, lifecycle and profiles are layered on the four core primitives.

invariant.statement: Every artifact exists exactly once, at one leading place, under one stable id. Anything else that shows its content is either a pointer to artifact@version or a declared projection that can be regenerated from its sources without loss. A hand-maintained copy or a reinterpretation that drops properties is a violation, not a feature.

quotes.text: Eine Spezifikation. Viele Ableitungen. Keine zweite Wahrheit. ... Fachliche Regeln werden einmal gefuehrt.
jede Information genau einmal und am richtigen Ort. Dokumente sind Sichten auf Informationen, nicht ihr Speicherort.
Jede fachliche Information wird genau einmal definiert, versioniert, entschieden und mit ihren Ableitungen verbunden.
[Repraesentationen] duerfen nicht unabhaengig voneinander zu neuen Wahrheiten werden.
Eine Spezifikation. Viele erzeugte Repraesentationen. Eine eigenstaendig evolvierbare Implementierung. Aber keine zweite Wahrheit.
Das Gegenmittel ist nicht mehr Dokumentation. Das Gegenmittel ist weniger doppelte Information.
Dokumente und andere Publikationsformen werden aus gefuehrten Informationen erzeugt oder referenzieren sie, statt eine zweite Wahrheit zu bilden.
Eine Ableitung ist nur dann belastbar, wenn die fuer ihren Zweck relevanten fachlichen Invarianten erhalten bleiben und dies ueberpruefbar ist.
Beziehungen statt Kopien ... Publikationen ... aus dem aktuellen Informationsstand erzeugt - nicht separat fortgeschrieben.
Generierte Dateien erhalten einen Versions- und Herkunftsnachweis. Manuelle Aenderungen an generierten Artefakten werden im Build erkannt.

artifact.meaning: The only place content is authored. Single home, stable id, versioned.

fields.id: stable, never reused; PREFIX-NNN for MORe types (IA §8.1), rule/field ids for spec elements (ELSTER §6.1)
fields.home: the leading place (system + locator); exactly one (BEL §3 'fuehrender Ort')
fields.version: monotonic; every content change creates a new version
fields.content: authored payload; only present at home

rules: no two artifacts may carry the same content-bearing field for the same fact (detect by content hash / declared fact keys)
an artifact held in an external system (git, GitHub, model registry) is NOT copied in; the board holds a pointer

shape.text: PLZ und Ort muessen zueinander passen

field_rules: separate meaning, type, optionality, dependencies and technical serialization (ELSTER Phase B, §7.3)

technical restrictions (e.g. xs:sequence order) are held as a technical derivation attribute (serializationOrder), never mixed into the business rule (ELSTER §7.3: 'Technische Restriktionen duerfen die Fachsemantik beeinflussen, aber sie duerfen sie nicht ersetzen')
preserve information states: absent != 'null' != 0.00 (ELSTER §2.2, §8.1); normalisation must not destroy them

pointer.meaning: Reference to artifact@version. Carries no content of its target. A pointer is how one artifact uses another.

fields.target_version: pinned version / commit sha / revision; 'floating' only allowed for navigation pointers and must be marked
fields.valid_to: timestamp or null; ending a pointer is a recorded change, never a hard delete

rules: an unpinned pointer claims every version of A fits every version of B (BEL §9) - only nav pointers may float
a pointer whose target version is superseded becomes 'suspect' until re-confirmed
pointer.src: BEL §9 'Ein Link ohne Versionsbezug behauptet stillschweigend, dass jede Fassung von A zu jeder Fassung von B passt.'

projection.meaning: A declared, pure derivation from source artifacts at pinned versions. Views, documents, generated schemas, caches, indexes, counts and mirrors are all projections.

fields.preserves: list of properties that must survive (invariants), e.g. meaning, type, optionality, ordering, completeness
fields.provenance: sources + function version embedded in output

rules: pure: same sources@versions + same function version => same output
regenerable: may be deleted and rebuilt at any time with no information loss
never hand-edited: edits go to the source artifact, then the projection is regenerated (ELSTER §13)
lossy is allowed only if declared: dropped properties must not be in 'preserves', and the projection must not be used where they matter
a projection cannot be the source of another artifact's content; only of other projections

derivable_set.excluded: application code ('model-driven bei der Spezifikation, nicht generator-driven bei der Implementierung')
derivable_set.note: 'Generieren heisst: Eine erzeugte Repraesentation darf nicht manuell zur zweiten Wahrheit werden.'

ordering_example.text: XML generator sorts deterministically by serializationOrder; XSD sequence is a projection property, not business semantics

drift_check.meaning: Mechanical test that the invariant holds. Any violation fails CI / blocks the gate.

violations.test: a copy of artifact content exists outside its home and differs from home@version
a copy exists outside its home at all (even if equal) and is not a declared projection
property listed in 'preserves' differs between source and output
target superseded since pointer was confirmed

drift_check.src: ELSTER §5.2 (four drift kinds), Phase D ('CI prueft Schema, Regeln, Regressionen und Artefaktdiffs'); BEL §10.4

validation_stages.src: ELSTER §9 (six stages, all tied to the same spec element/rule ids)
stages: source_and_mapping (absent/null/value classified; each source column -> exactly one field)
business_plausibility (paired fields, conditional, Kz10 null rules)
integration (actual acceptance by target; deviations to local validator recorded)
regression_golden_files (versioned valid/invalid examples; spec change yields artifact diff)
validation_stages.rule: a production-accepted example file is not a hidden spec; it becomes a regression test with known provenance and scope (ELSTER §9)

impact_analysis.text: changing a rule yields the concrete affected chain (spec section, story, test cases, release evidence -> 're-check'), not a list of possibly stale documents

runtime_divergence.text: accepted runtime behaviour may diverge from strict local validation (Kz84/85 order accepted for months, rejected by xmllint). Record as evidence with result 'objected'/'deviation'; do not 'fix' by copying behaviour into code

event.meaning: An immutable, append-only record that something was decided, verified, included, superseded, overruled or moved. Events are the only write path for state changes; artifact state, pointer validity, status and PR/issue views are projections (folds) over events.

envelope.id: content hash or minted id; never reused
envelope.actor: DID of the asserting party; on_behalf_of for agents
envelope.pinned_against: artifact@version / commit / baseline the claim was made against (required)
envelope.supersedes: link(s) to superseded event or artifact@version

KORU 082171caf merge: names pins + concept; merges never squashed

KORU correct/Severs (20), f284251ba Lars quote + Severs + Provenance

MORe single_home: changing the leading place is a recorded change of home, not a copy

rules: no update, no delete: ending anything is an event
move with changed content is refused (split into move + supersession)
verification without pinned_against is 'unmeasured' and satisfies no gate
a belief/decision-class signal requires an event on the subject in the same transaction

projections.issue_view: fold over events with subject=issue: open decisions, latest verification per check, inclusions, supersession chain
projections.pr_view: projection of one inclusion event (into, from-range) + verifications pinned to its head; description generated, not authored
projections.status: derived: Ready = no open decision on subject + DoR; Done = inclusion + passing verification pinned to included version; hand-set status = drift

event.migration_src: ELSTER §10 'Die Umstellung muss nicht mit einem Big Bang beginnen … manuellen Kopien Schritt für Schritt durch Ableitungen ersetzen' — the same phased cutover applies: existing board status/fields become projections of backfilled events

relations.note: Every relation is a typed pointer (version-pinned). Relations never copy target content.

implements.preserves: required (checked via tests, not regeneration; code is not a projection)

evidence.rule: Evidence is an artifact (authored once) asserting that pointer P between A@x and B@y holds; author, time, method, result. Several may coexist.

claim_types.source: MP p.5-6 (B.0/2): 'Jede Beziehung hat einen anderen Nachweisanspruch'
claim_types.gaps_vs_kernel: represented_by, validated_by and accepted_by have no kernel type yet; proposed as additions, each declaring its evidence claim. MP B.3.2 plans 'Beziehungstypen als feste Liste' in the glossary; that list is not in MP.
claim_types.rule: relations are attributes of the existing relation layer, not a new layer (MP p.6 B.1; p.10 'Keine vierte Framework-Schicht')

artifact_types.baseline: BL, a set of pinned pointers (artifacts AND relations), BEL §5.3
artifact_types.implementation: external artifact (code, story); held in its own home, pointed to, never copied; NOT a projection (ELSTER §6)

projection_kinds.generated_representation: XSD/API schema, field catalogue, validator, generated tests (ELSTER §6)
projection_kinds.board_view: list/kanban/timeline/story map (MAN artifacts; BEL §7 'vier Sichten auf denselben Bestand')
projection_kinds.aggregate: counts, status rollups, unread badges - must be computed or declared caches with drift check
projection_kinds.mirror: read-only display of an external artifact's content, always with source@version + regenerated, never edited

gates.invariant_gate: every gate first runs drift_check on the artifacts it touches; any violation blocks

checks: work item POINTS to the leading spec instead of restating it (MAN DoR)
all generated representations from the same spec version
implementation passes AC+tests of that version
production evidence points to released spec version

lifecycle.note: Each stage is a separate artifact connected by pointers; stages never restate the previous stage (IA §9 'ergaenzt den vorherigen Informationsstand, ohne ihn zu wiederholen').

demo_chain.rule: 'Die Story verweist auf UC-042 und enthaelt nur den konkreten Arbeitsauftrag'

cutover.kind: domain profile; orthogonal to the strictness ladder light → standard → controlled → ai_regulated and combinable with any rung
cutover.invariant: + baseline immutable after publish; forecast changes only through an approved reflow decision; actuals append-only, corrected only by supersession
cutover.event_mapping_note: reflowProposed is an open decision and reflowApproved the decided one (decided_by = approver); an authorized reflowApproved also emits a supersession of the proposal events, so the open decision closes; a correction supersedes the corrected event; observations are production-stage verifications without gate or witness, so they never count as gate-accepted evidence for done; the baselinePublished inclusion names cutover and every task:<id> of the baseline, so observations about a task follow an inclusion of that subject (production_evidence rule)
cutover.status: task statuses (planned, ready, active, completed, blocked, failed, skipped, rollback) are folds over the live log: superseded events and decisions by unauthorized deciders do not count; no event sets a status
cutover.implementation: kernel/Cutover (Lean 4): Cutover/Profile.lean maps every cut-over event to a MORe event; more-check compares this mapping with the Lean classification
cutover.src: KIRA cut-over calculus (feat/kira-lean-cutover-kernel, docs/GROBKONZEPT.md, docs/PLAN.md); reflow has no MORe source, so it lives in this profile, not in the core

profiles.rule: profiles add types and strictness; the invariant itself is never optional

zoho_lesson.text: ZOHO is the counter-example: rebuilding a classic document template (legend, abbreviations, empty chapters) is not MORe. For that UC: wish, analysis result, decision, optional AC, evidence of standard function.

configuration_states.src: ZOHO p.6 status legend (KM-Plan); BEL §9 Requirement Yogi

transitions.in_bearbeitung->vorgelegt: author done, put under KM control, QS review
transitions.freigegeben->(new version): 'darf nur noch innerhalb einer neuen Version geaendert werden'

configuration_states.rule: released artifacts are immutable; change = new version. Release state is reachable only when required fields are present (BEL §9)
configuration_states.note: this is the artifact/document configuration lifecycle; distinct from work-item status (Jira) and from the requirement chain

decision_record.home: attached to the use case, or a 'Entscheidung' ticket type (ZOHO §8.8 'Alternativ: Ticket-Typ-Entscheidung')

zoho_example.decision: Umsetzung erfolgt nicht. Die Funktion ist im CRM bereits vorhanden (Kontakt -> offene Aktivitaet -> Meeting)

decision_record.note: a decision can close a use case with no implementation; the decision plus evidence of the standard function is the whole trace (BEL §4.3)

evidence_record_practice.src: ZOHO version table (pageVersion links); BEL §5.2 ('Abnahme bezieht sich ausdruecklich auf einen identifizierten Versionsstand'); DEMO release stage
evidence_record_practice.pattern: evidence points to artifact@version (Confluence pageVersion=N, release 2026.09, productive version 4.12.0, acceptance date)
evidence_record_practice.acceptance_is_state_not_date: BEL §6.2: Abnahme shifts from a single date to a verifiable baseline state

views_by_role.rule: same stock, role-filtered projections; no separate backlogs

not_in_sources.finding: No source page, PDF or demo bundle describes reflow or cut-over as a MORe mechanism. Cut-over appears only as an example domain (BEL §7.3 UC-COP-011 'Cut-over-Bestand im Board anzeigen', DEC-COP-001). Schedule baseline/forecast/actual and reflow are board/cut-over-tool concepts; MORe 'Baseline' = configuration baseline (BEL §5.3, §6.2). Keep them under projections.lolaplex-board.

board_only_config.note: kept from v1 so PR #28 semantics survive; these are board concerns, not MORe

follow.semantics: soft ordering; a view hint, not a MORe relation

board_only_config.schedule_layers_note: board-specific; not MORe. Do not name the schedule layer 'baseline' in MORe-facing APIs (clashes with configuration baseline).

notes_v4.reflow_cutover: Checked against JWF (the bibliography's Jira workflow, supplied 2026-10-17): it contains no reflow and no cutover. Reflow has no MORe source; cut-over appears only in BEL §7.3 as the domain of DEC-COP-001 (a decision event). Board schedule reflow remains a board concern. If the plugin Fabian's father built had reflow/cutover, it is not in this neutralised deck; a different artifact (plugin workflow XML) would be needed. Update 2026-10-18: reflow and cut-over now have a MORe home as the domain profile layers.profiles.cutover (from the KIRA cut-over kernel); the core still has no reflow.

derived_status.rule: Status is never set. No event type or verb writes a status; every status is a fold over events.
derived_status.ready: no open decision event on the subject + DoR
derived_status.verified: among the gate-accepted test verifications pinned to subject@v, the latest one per check (gate and method) decides: at least one passes and none fails. A later result replaces an earlier one of the same check only, so a pass on one check of a gate never hides a fail on another check of that gate. Sources: core_primitives projections.issue_view 'latest verification per check'; JWF p.10 QG 2 'Tests erfolgreich'; BEL p.22 'Über dieselbe fachliche Relation können mehrere, auch widersprüchliche Nachweise nebeneinander bestehen'. Fabian, 2026-10-19: per check, not per gate (Lean latestPerCheck)
derived_status.done: inclusion event (release/baseline) of subject@v AND a gate-accepted, passing verification pinned_against subject@v; a verification pinned to another version does not count

chain.note: WPUS: acceptance 'is more than a status change. It is the decision'; links requirement, tests and the version accepted

derived_status.gates: No gate on moving to done, because there is no move to done; gates digest witnesses into verification events.

hierarchy.source: LEI (Practitioner Training): 'die Hierarchie von Fachgebiet über Anwendungsfall bis zu BP, CM, UI, API, TC, AC und DEC — Jede Ebene beantwortet genau eine Frage. Nicht mehr, nicht weniger.'
hierarchy.rule: one_question_per_level: each level declares exactly one question (level.question) in the profile; each node must answer its level's question and no other level's
hierarchy.question_texts: Declared in hierarchy.questions. English is canonical; German is the source wording. 8 of 9 are verbatim from IA v1.4 §9; Fachgebiet is proposed. AC stays 'business fulfilment' only: IA §15.2 also hangs production evidence on AC, but the kernel keeps production evidence as its own step after release inclusion.

flags.check: node has no content addressing its level question (empty/placeholder answer field)
node carries content belonging to another level's question (e.g. a UC restating AC or a DEC rationale) instead of a pointer to that node

lint.relation_to_invariant: answering two questions is a duplicate home for one of them; the fix is split + pointer

Fachgebiet.en: Which use cases belong together in this domain, and how do they relate?
Fachgebiet.src: proposed from IA v1.4 §8 p.11 (domain summary page: overview of the domain, its use cases and their connection); IA §9 table has no Fachgebiet row

Anwendungsfall.en: What does the user want to achieve?

BP.en: How does it work from a business perspective?

CM.en: Which terms and data are we working with?
CM.de: Mit welchen Begriffen und Daten wird gearbeitet?

UI.en: How does the user interact with the system?
UI.de: Wie interagiert der Nutzer mit dem System?

AC.en: When is the requirement fulfilled from a business perspective?
AC.de: Wann ist die Anforderung fachlich erfüllt?

DEC.en: Why is it solved this way?

compliance_matrix.source: LEI (Compliance Intensiv / Aufbaumodul): map MORe structure to evidence duties of DORA, NIS2, KRITIS-Dachgesetz, MaRisk, ISO 27001 — 'Welche MORe-Ebene liefert welchen Nachweis', DEC 'revisionssicher', result 'eine Mapping-Matrix'
inputs: regulation_requirement artifacts (one per duty, ID + version of the regulation text)
maps_to pointers: requirement -> (hierarchy level, event type)
compliance_matrix.function: for each duty: level + event type that evidences it, plus the live events satisfying it per subject@version; gaps = duties with no satisfying event
compliance_matrix.mappings: not specified on the site; declared per organisation, not invented here

governance_concepts.status_model: a declared state machine per artifact kind; every state is a derived fold over events (see derived_status), transitions are event types, never writes
governance_concepts.approval_path: a declared sequence of required decision events (approver role, subject@version) that a derived state needs
governance_concepts.source: LEI: Assessment analyses 'Statusmodelle, Freigabewege'; Pilot builds 'Statusmodelle, Entscheidungen, Tests und Nachweise' in Jira/Confluence. Neither is specified on the site.

principles.one_inventory: boards are views, no second truths (JWF p.4-5, p.9)
principles.status_is_maturity: states describe maturity and responsibility (p.5, p.8)
principles.every_transition_leaves_history: acceptance and production refer to a concrete version/Stand (p.5)

jira_status_model.transitions: forward order within and across phases as listed (JWF p.8). Optional states may be dropped per project; the chain must stay intact (p.8). The deck shows no backward transitions, no rework loop and no per-transition conditions beyond the three QGs.

QG1.name: Ready für Umsetzung
QG1.question: Kann sinnvoll umgesetzt werden?
QG1.reaches_src: JWF p.7: column 'DoR / QG 1' ends with 'Fertig für Einplanung'; Fertig für Einplanung = Ready

QG2.name: Ready für Abnahme
QG2.reaches_src: JWF p.10: 'QG 2 Ready für Abnahme'; 'Die Bedingungen liegen dort, wo der Status wechselt.' QG2 is the transition into In Abnahme, not the acceptance itself

guard_mapping.Umsetzung fertig: an implements claim from subject@version is met (JWF p.7 DoD: 'Fertig entwickelte Arbeit'; state Fertig zum Testen)
guard_mapping.Tests erfolgreich: derived_status.verified: the latest test verification per check (gate and method) passes, pinned to subject@version, and no latest one fails
guard_mapping.Entscheidungen nachvollziehbar: no open decision on the subject; a decided decision names its decider and carries its time (BEL p.18: 'Variante, Entscheider und Datum sind dokumentiert')
guard_mapping.not_a_guard: a separate 'UAT release' decision: p.10 lists none for QG2; the 'Freigabe' of p.7 is the acceptance decision (jira_status_model.acceptance)
guard_mapping.consequence: every QG2 guard is already implied by QG1 (no open decision), Fertig zum Testen and Test abgeschlossen, so the derived walk never stops at Test abgeschlossen (Lean not_test_abgeschlossen). JWF p.8 allows this: 'Optionale Status können projektspezifisch entfallen.'

QG3.name: Produktiver Stand
QG3.reaches_src: JWF p.7: 'Produktion / QG 3 ... Produktiver und geschlossener Stand'

guard_mapping.freigegeben: the acceptance decision (jira_status_model.acceptance); the Freigabe of JWF p.7 'Fachliche Prüfung und Freigabe', modelled once
guard_mapping.Release zugeordnet: an inclusion event of subject@version into a release baseline (core_primitives.event.types.inclusion)
guard_mapping.Produktions-/Change-Status dokumentiert: a passing, gate-accepted production verification pinned to the release baseline, after the inclusion (derived_status.proven_in_production)
guard_mapping.not_a_guard: a separate release approval decision by Release/Team: p.10 lists no decision for QG3, and the p.9 Release / Team board shows 'Freigegebene Stände', i.e. states that are already released

gates.rule: conditions are checked at the transition where status changes, not moved before the work (p.10)

acceptance.decision: a decided decision event with topic acceptance_decision and an acceptance (outcome, linked passing test verifications), pinned to subject@version, by a principal holding one of the profile's acceptor roles. It is the latest acceptance on subject@version (derived_status.accepted)
acceptance.roles_rule: the profile sets acceptor_roles; a profile may narrow the default
acceptance.is_also: the QG3 guard 'freigegeben': one Freigabe, not modelled twice
src: JWF p.7: 'UAT & Abnahme / QG 2 ... Fachliche Prüfung und Freigabe'
JWF p.9: PO / Fachbereich board 'fachliche Abnahme'; Test / Abnahme board 'Abnahmeentscheidung'
IA v1.4 p.13, AC: 'fachlich erfüllt?' ... 'Abnahmeentscheidung, Nachweis'
BEL §5.2: 'Die Abnahme bezieht sich ausdrücklich auf einen identifizierten Versionsstand.'

jira_status_model.approval_path: JWF names one approval: the Freigabe / Abnahmeentscheidung (p.7 'Fachliche Prüfung und Freigabe'; p.9 'fachliche Abnahme', 'Abnahmeentscheidung'). It is the acceptance decision (jira_status_model.acceptance), which reaches Abgenommen and is the QG3 guard 'freigegeben'. No gate has a further approval step: p.10 lists no decision among the QG guards. Board roles: PO/Fachbereich, Entwicklung, Test/Abnahme, Release/Team (p.9).

mapping_to_v4.note: Jira states are kept as a derived status model (governance_concepts.status_model): each state is a fold over v4 events, never written. Mapping is ours; the deck does not use event vocabulary.
mapping_to_v4.Neu..In technischer Beschreibung: derived from decision events (selection, open DECs) and authored artifacts
mapping_to_v4.Fertig für Einplanung (=Ready): derived: no open decision + QG1 guards held as verification events pinned to subject@v
mapping_to_v4.Fertig für Entwicklung..Fertig zum Teste: derived from implementation pointers + verification events (technische QS)
mapping_to_v4.In Abnahme / Abgenommen: In Abnahme = QG2 held (implements claim met + verified + no open decision). Abgenommen = the acceptance decision (jira_status_model.acceptance), a decision event, never a status
mapping_to_v4.Produktion: derived_status.done: inclusion into a release (Release zugeordnet) + verified + accepted. Kernel derivation: JWF gives the state no condition; the p.9 Release / Team board lists 'Freigegebene Stände, Release-Zuordnung, Produktionsstatus, offene Nachweise'
mapping_to_v4.Geschlossen: QG3 held (JWF p.7: 'Produktion / QG 3 ... Produktiver und geschlossener Stand'): acceptance decision + inclusion + production verification pinned to the release baseline (derived_status.proven_in_production); derived terminal fold, no event writes it. Geschlossen implies derived_status.done; done alone is not Geschlossen
mapping_to_v4.Done: the deck has no 'Done' state, only DoD as a phase (p.7). Any Jira 'Done' maps to derived_status.done; setting 'Done' or 'Geschlossen' by hand is status_hand_set

jira_status_model.reflow_cutover: NOT in JWF. Neither word nor any rescheduling, rollback or cut-over step appears in the 13 pages. The v3 finding stands: reflow has no MORe source; cut-over appears only as BEL §7.3 example domain (UC-COP-011/DEC-COP-001).

kernel_additions.note: rules of the JWF mapping with no source text; kept on purpose (more-lean-model.md §12a)

decision.topic.rule: a decision event names the question it answers (e.g. 'acceptance_decision'); the kernel reads only acceptance_decision
decision.topic.reason: without it, any decided decision with an acceptance (e.g. an unrelated PO decision) would count as the acceptance decision
not_in: IA v1.4 p.13 DEC: 'Festlegung, Alternativen, Begründung, Datum, Entscheider'
decision.topic.tension: BEL §7.3.1 p.17: 'Neben den Jira-Standardfeldern genügen zwei zusätzliche Felder. Ein separates Feld „Bezug“ ist unnötig: Die betroffenen Informationsobjekte werden über die semantischen Links bestimmt.' topic is not Bezug: it names the kind of decision, not the affected objects (subjects, pinned_against, pointers)

verification.stage.review.rule: each QG1 guard is a verification of stage review, pinned to subject@version, whose method names the guard; a review never counts as a test verification
verification.stage.review.reason: the QG1 guards are understanding checks, not tests (JWF p.10: 'Ziel verstanden', 'Akzeptanzkriterien ausreichend', 'wesentliche Risiken bekannt'); an unpinned review is drift like any verification ('verification without pinned_against is unmeasured and satisfies no gate', core_primitives rules)
verification.stage.review.not_in: the stage name review has no source

derivation_invariants.principle: Eine Ableitung ist nur dann belastbar, wenn die für ihren Zweck relevanten fachlichen Invarianten erhalten bleiben und dies überprüfbar ist.
derivation_invariants.check: machine-checkable against XSD, validator and test coverage; result is a Ableitungsnachweis artifact (MP p.7) = a verification event pinned to source@v and derivation@v

purpose_indexed_equivalence.statement: A quotient map is one equivalence relation; MORe needs a family of purpose-indexed relations: what is indistinguishable for verification is not for acceptance, and differs again for operations/monitoring.
purpose_indexed_equivalence.consequence: preserves[] is indexed by purpose (verification|acceptance|operations); one projection can be valid for one purpose and not another. Relevant to agents-memory quotient-tower SPEC.
purpose_indexed_equivalence.boundary: MP p.7 C.0 / p.10: formal semantics is not part of the MORe core; MORe defines which information, relations, derivations and evidence are kept and each relation's evidence claim.
